pr_title: dev-cmd/bump-*-pr: avoid installing gems when unneeded.

issue_context.title: Only call install_bundler_gems if needed
issue_context.body:
### Verification

- [X] This issue's title and/or description do not reference a single formula e.g. `brew install wget`. If they do, open an issue at https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/issues/new/choose instead.

### Provide a detailed description of the proposed feature

We call this function https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/master/Library/Homebrew/dev-cmd/bump-formula-pr.rb#L120 on bump-formula-pr because audit needs it. However, this does not need to be called if the `no-audit=true` flag is provided right? 

Can we disable this call when not needed? Happy to submit a PR if you think this request is reasonable. 

### What is the motivation for the feature?

We run bump-formula-pr in out automation scripts for cloudflared with `no-audit`. The bundle install seems quite unncessary on clean builds. 

### How will the feature be relevant to at least 90% of Homebrew users?

This will only be relevant to automated runs of bump-formula-pr from clean environments which force a gem bundle build every time. 

### What alternatives to the feature have been considered?

a custom variant of this script can be run but that seems ugly.
